newsitem.title: FRANCE: Charity estimates 13,600 Zaire refugee deaths.
newsitem.headline: Charity estimates 13,600 Zaire refugee deaths.

text.p: A senior medical aid worker in Paris estimated on Friday that more than 13,600 refugees in eastern Zaire had died of deprivation over the past three weeks, not including victims of the fighting.
Bernard Pecoul, Director-General of Medecins sans Frontieres (Doctors Without Borders - MSF), said the average assessment in such situations was that 10 of 10,000 refugees died every day.
"We can therefore estimate that more than 13,600 people have died since the crisis started 21 days ago," he told reporters, referring to fighting between Zairean forces and Tutsi rebels.

He said 200,000 refugees in the area of Uvira had been without relief for the past three weeks, 300,000 around Bukavu were without aid for two weeks and 700,000 in the Goma area had ceased receiving aid a week ago.
